note: Golden file: the Swift tests own `expect` and rewrite it with HASALA_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 (conformance/README.md); add or change an input by hand. Each stream is read in order by CoreExtract's CombinedReader with one LearnedLayouts that starts empty; `expect` has one reading per mail. All inputs are synthetic. See README.md.
